newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen down on closure of finance cos.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen down on closure of finance cos.

text.p: Market jitters over a government decision to suspend operations of 42 finance firms would cause investors to unload bank and finance stocks on Wednesday and drive the market down, brokers said.

"I think investors would remain worried for the next few days over the government order for the suspension of 42 finance companies. In long run the remaining 33 healthy finance firms and 15 commercial banks would gain more confidence from the public," said Thanadech Mahapokai of Book Club Finance.
The composite SET index closed 15.35 points lower at 648.47 on 6.6 billion baht turnover on Tuesday.
Apart from the suspension of 42 finance firms, the government also moved to hike the value added tax to 10 percent from seven and imposed strict monetary and fiscal targets for the next few years.

If the measures were properly implemented, the government hopes to get $12-$15 billion in loans from the International Monetary Fund and foreign nations, Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya said on Tuesday.
